---
title: "Chinese Personnel and Organization Work Timeline"
subtitle: "组织人事工作大事记"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

## What this is

Below, you will find an interactive explorer for personnel and organization work in the Chinese Reform Era (1978–1997). In total, there are about 2,700 organization work entries and 170 personnel work entries. Naturally, there's some overlap between these entries, but they are not the same, and even when they note the same event, the events are glossed differently.

I compiled these entries from three sources I collected, scanned, OCR'd, and manually corrected: first, three timelines of significant events from the Research Office of the Central Organization Department — one covering 1978–1988, another covering 1989–1992, and a third covering 1993–1997. These cover not just relevant meetings, speeches, the release of relevant reports, and some statistics, but also the appointments and removals of significant figures. To these, I also added a less-exhaustive set of "personnel work" events from Xu and Sun's 2009 book, "Reform of China's Personnel Institutions, 1978–2008" (for the overlapping years).^[中共中央组织部研究室《党的组织工作大事记》(1978-1988,1989-1992,1993-1997); 徐颂陶 & 孙建立,《中国人事制度改革（1978-2008）》.]

As you explore, please note that the format of entries changes over time; while some entries were possible to separate into discrete events, others list *multiple events* that took place on the same day. The Chinese text is the authoritative version. These data are provided for reference only; I make no guarantees as to their completeness or accuracy.

---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)

data <- read_csv("组织人事工作大事记1978-1997_split.csv") |>
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      type == "人事工作" ~ "Personnel Work",
      type == "组织工作" ~ "Org. Work",
      type == "任免"     ~ "Appointments & Removals",
      .default = NA_character_
    ),
    date    = as.Date(start_date),
    year    = if_else(!is.na(date), as.integer(year(date)), NA_integer_),
    date_fmt = if_else(!is.na(date), format(date, "%b %d, %Y"), "Unknown date")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(category)) |>
  arrange(date) |>
  transmute(
    category,
    year     = replace_na(year, 0L),
    date_fmt,
    zh       = events,
    en       = translated_text
  )

json <- toJSON(data, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
cat(paste0('<script>const TIMELINE_DATA = ', json, ';</script>\n'))
```

```{=html}
      <input type="range" id="range-min" min="1978" max="1997" value="1978" step="1">
      <input type="range" id="range-max" min="1978" max="1997" value="1997" step="1">

<div id="tl-timeline"></div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // Position sticky bar below the Quarto site navbar
  function setControlsTop() {
    var nav = document.getElementById('quarto-header') ||
              document.querySelector('nav.navbar') ||
              document.querySelector('header');
    var h = nav ? nav.offsetHeight : 0;
    document.getElementById('tl-controls').style.top = h + 'px';
  }
  setControlsTop();
  window.addEventListener('resize', setControlsTop);

  // ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var lang        = 'en';
  var activeCats  = new Set(['Org. Work', 'Personnel Work', 'Appointments & Removals']);
  var query       = '';
  var searchTimer = null;
  var revealObs   = null;
  var YEAR_MIN    = 1978;
  var YEAR_MAX    = 1997;
  var yearMin     = YEAR_MIN;
  var yearMax     = YEAR_MAX;

  // ── Filter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function getFiltered() {
    var q = query.toLowerCase();
    return TIMELINE_DATA.filter(function (d) {
      if (!activeCats.has(d.category)) return false;
      if (d.year < yearMin || d.year > yearMax) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      var text = (lang === 'en' ? d.en : d.zh) || '';
      return text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 ||
             (d.date_fmt || '').toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
    });
  }

  // ── Group by year ────────────────────────────────────────────
  function groupByYear(data) {
    var map = new Map();
    for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
      var yr = data[i].year || 0;
      if (!map.has(yr)) map.set(yr, []);
      map.get(yr).push(data[i]);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries()).sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; });
  }

  // ── HTML helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  function escapeHTML(str) {
    return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
  }

  function escapeRegex(str) {
    return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  }

  function highlightedHTML(text, q) {
    if (!q) return escapeHTML(text);
    var re = new RegExp(escapeRegex(q), 'gi');
    var result = '';
    var last = 0;
    var match;
    while ((match = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
      result += escapeHTML(text.slice(last, match.index));
      result += '<mark>' + escapeHTML(match[0]) + '</mark>';
      last = match.index + match[0].length;
    }
    return result + escapeHTML(text.slice(last));
  }

  // ── Build entry HTML ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function entryHTML(item) {
    var text     = (lang === 'en' ? item.en : item.zh) || '—';
    var catCls   = item.category === 'Org. Work'               ? 'cat-org'
                 : item.category === 'Appointments & Removals' ? 'cat-appt'
                 : 'cat-personnel';
    var tagCls   = item.category === 'Org. Work'               ? 'tag-org'
                 : item.category === 'Appointments & Removals' ? 'tag-appt'
                 : 'tag-personnel';
    var textCls  = lang === 'zh' ? 'entry-text zh-text' : 'entry-text';
    var escaped  = highlightedHTML(text, query);
    return '<div class="timeline-entry ' + catCls + '">' +
      '<div class="entry-meta">' +
        '<span class="entry-date">' + (item.date_fmt || 'Unknown date') + '</span>' +
        '<span class="entry-tag ' + tagCls + '">' + item.category + '</span>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<p class="' + textCls + '">' + escaped + '</p>' +
    '</div>';
  }

  // ── Scroll-reveal via IntersectionObserver ───────────────────
  function setupReveal(container) {
    if (revealObs) { revealObs.disconnect(); revealObs = null; }
    revealObs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (e) {
        if (e.isIntersecting) {
          e.target.classList.add('visible');
          revealObs.unobserve(e.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.04, rootMargin: '0px 0px -20px 0px' });

    var items = container.querySelectorAll('.timeline-entry');
    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      revealObs.observe(items[i]);
    }
  }

  // ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function render() {
    var filtered  = getFiltered();
    var container = document.getElementById('tl-timeline');
    var countEl   = document.getElementById('tl-count');
    var total     = TIMELINE_DATA.length;

    countEl.textContent = filtered.length.toLocaleString() + ' of ' +
                          total.toLocaleString() + ' entries';

    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = '<div id="tl-empty">No entries match your filters.</div>';
      return;
    }

    var groups = groupByYear(filtered);
    var html   = '';
    for (var g = 0; g < groups.length; g++) {
      var yr    = groups[g][0];
      var items = groups[g][1];
      var label = yr === 0 ? 'Unknown year' : String(yr);
      html += '<div class="year-section">' +
        '<div class="year-header"><span class="year-label">' + label + '</span></div>' +
        '<div class="year-entries">';
      for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        html += entryHTML(items[i]);
      }
      html += '</div></div>';
    }
    container.innerHTML = html;
    setupReveal(container);
  }

  // ── Wire up controls ─────────────────────────────────────────
  function init() {
    // Language buttons
    document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(function (b) {
          b.classList.remove('active');
        });
        btn.classList.add('active');
        lang = btn.dataset.lang;
        render();
      });
    });

    // Category checkboxes
    document.querySelectorAll('.cat-check').forEach(function (cb) {
      cb.addEventListener('change', function () {
        if (cb.checked) activeCats.add(cb.value);
        else activeCats.delete(cb.value);
        render();
      });
    });

    // Search (debounced 200 ms)
    document.getElementById('tl-search').addEventListener('input', function (e) {
      clearTimeout(searchTimer);
      var val = e.target.value;
      searchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        query = val;
        render();
      }, 200);
    });

    // Date range slider
    var sliderMin  = document.getElementById('range-min');
    var sliderMax  = document.getElementById('range-max');
    var fillEl     = document.getElementById('range-fill');
    var minValEl   = document.getElementById('range-min-val');
    var maxValEl   = document.getElementById('range-max-val');

    function updateSlider() {
      var pct1 = (yearMin - YEAR_MIN) / (YEAR_MAX - YEAR_MIN) * 100;
      var pct2 = (yearMax - YEAR_MIN) / (YEAR_MAX - YEAR_MIN) * 100;
      fillEl.style.left  = pct1 + '%';
      fillEl.style.width = (pct2 - pct1) + '%';
      minValEl.textContent = yearMin;
      maxValEl.textContent = yearMax;
    }

    sliderMin.addEventListener('input', function () {
      yearMin = Math.min(parseInt(this.value), yearMax);
      this.value = yearMin;
      updateSlider();
      render();
    });

    sliderMax.addEventListener('input', function () {
      yearMax = Math.max(parseInt(this.value), yearMin);
      this.value = yearMax;
      updateSlider();
      render();
    });

    updateSlider();
    render();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
}());
</script>
```
